acquirer.name: Tortoise North American Pipeline Fund (as a series of Managed Portfolio Series)

announcement.quote: The purpose of the Meeting is to seek your approval of an Agreement and Plan of Reorganization for the Tortoise North American Pipeline Fund (the”Fund”) to move from a series of Montage Managers Trust to a series of Managed Portfolio Series.

deals.notes: A trust-to-trust reorganization of one fund ('The investment objective, strategies and policies of the Fund are not changing'), not a merger of two funds. The 2016-12-06 PRE 14A (Montage Managers Trust, seq 5) describes an Acquired Fund and Acquiring Fund unnamed; the N-14s of 2017-04-07 and 2017-05-11 follow. No excerpt states listing status or the outcome. The other proxy filings in the window (Torray, Tortoise, Port Street) are investment advisory agreement approvals, not mergers.

problems: The filer is a fund trust; the fund pairs in the 2016 N-14 are unnamed in the excerpts. Episode role not stated. Neither outcome is stated.
